name: The language of a single script
description: A script that runs from its first line to its last, with no user subprograms and no classes. It has declarations and assignment, expressions and operators, control flow, strings with interpolation, the primitive types and the collections, and jobs with error recovery. This level is the core of the lexical and syntactic specification, the first lexer and parser, and the tree-walking interpreter, which stay the reference for the bytecode machine.

features.name: Console I/O
features.summary: print, write, read, error, warning, log_err, log_wrn.

features.name: Exception module
features.summary: Error, Warning, raise, expect, assert, warn, code constants.

features.name: DataMap methods
features.summary: has, get(k), get(k, default), keys, values, delete.

features.name: Script shapes
features.summary: Aspect with process main, title/subtitle header, comments; no free script and no #!.

features.name: Expressions and operators
features.summary: Arithmetic, logic, comparison, ranges, membership, precedence.

features.name: Control flow
features.summary: if, match, while, for, loop … repeat [while c], labels, break, skip.

features.name: Jobs and error recovery
features.summary: Jobs, recover with retry/resume/abort, finalize, raise, expect, over, panic, exit codes.

features.name: Primitive types
features.summary: Integer, Natural, Real, Logic, Symbol, String, ordinals, type checks with is.

features.name: Collections
features.summary: List, Array, Matrix, DataSet, HashMap, Object, slices, builders, deconstruction.

features.name: Strings and interpolation
features.summary: Escapes, text literal """, placeholders {name}, {literal}, simple expressions and formats {n % i5}, code points {U+H}, HTML entities &name;, regular expressions (subset).

features.name: Lexical specification
features.summary: Tokens, comments, literals, escapes, placeholders, keywords, operators, delimiters as Markdown + JSON.

features.name: Grammar (EBNF)
features.summary: Declarations, statements, expressions, modules and imports, checked against every .eve test by script/grammarcheck.py (199 of 199 files of levels 1 to 4 and the smoke test).

features.name: Core semantics
features.summary: Types, scopes, control flow, jobs and recover, topology, collections and objects.

features.name: Command-line parameters of a script
features.summary: -p/--param mapped to main parameters, eve script.eve -h from  @param comments.

features.name: System variables
features.summary: The register ($error, environment names such as $HOME, $epsilon, $err_/$wrn_ constants).

features.name: Exit code of the program
features.summary: over n; and exit n; give the exit code: 0, or 6 to 125 (1 to 5 belong to the machine); anything else is $err_argument.

features.name: Lexer and parser
features.summary: Source to syntax tree, errors with file, line and column (lexer.zig, parser.zig).

features.name: Tree-walking interpreter
features.summary: Runs levels 1 to 3, the smoke test and the benchmarks (interp.zig, project.zig); 193 tests.
